## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-01-21: Form-of TRA first attached to S-1/A as Exhibit 10.2
- 2021-01-27: Form-of TRA re-filed in S-1/A without substantive change
- 2021-02-11: TRA executed at IPO close; loanDepot Inc. (Anthony Hsieh signing for the Corporation, LD Holdings LLC, and the JLSSAA Trust) and Parthenon entities (Parthenon Investors III/IV, PCap Associates, Parthenon Capital Partners Funds, PCP Managers)
- 2021-02-16: 8-K Item 1.01 files the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.2

#### Post-IPO balance evolution

- 2021-12-31: Year-end TRA liability $32.9M (up from $8.6M at end Q1 2021)
- 2024-12-31: Liability $80.2M
- 2025-12-31: Liability $109.1M; no cash payments under the TRA yet realized
- 2026-03-31: Liability $111.0M

## Explanation

loanDepot, Inc. executed the TRA on February 11, 2021 at its NYSE Up-C IPO close, agreeing to pay 85% of cash tax savings the Corporation realizes from Section 754 basis step-ups arising on Continuing LLC Members' exchanges of Holdco Units for Class A common stock (plus imputed interest on TRA payments themselves) to three recipient categories: the Parthenon Stockholders, Parthenon affiliates holding Holdco Units, and certain Continuing LLC Members including Anthony Hsieh and the JLSSAA Trust. No amendments, restatements, terminations, or change-of-control events have occurred since execution. The accrued liability has grown from $8.6M at Q1 2021 to $111.0M at Q1 2026 as members exchanged and triggered step-ups, but loanDepot has not yet realized any cash tax savings under the contract; the carrying liability reflects management's more-likely-than-not view that the related deferred tax assets will be realized in the future. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
